text: そんな　ちゃらちゃら　した　かっこうで　たたかうなってーっ！

structure.jp: そんな　ちゃらちゃら　した　かっこうで

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after the plain form of a verb is a rough order not to do it. たたかうな = 'don't fight'.

patterns.name: 〜って (quoting)
patterns.explanation: って at the end repeats your own words with annoyance: 'I'm telling you'. たたかうなってー = 'I said don't fight!'

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here says in what state something is done. かっこうで = 'dressed in that getup'.
